verdict: Leads are low this period; overdue setup items are the root cause.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 8 leads on $1,724.75 in ad spend, with cost per lead rising 33% week-over-week to $215.59 — a soft stretch, and the data points to a clear reason. Six planned milestones are past due, including confirming an intake owner, re-enabling LSA heating toggles, and launching the booking bot — each one limits how many leads can enter and be acted on before fall heating season. On the Google Business Profile side, two of your three profiles are showing impressions but converting them to calls at a fraction of the rate your strongest profile achieves, leaving local intent on the table. We are working through the overdue items now, with LSA heating toggles and the intake owner confirmation as the immediate priorities, and fall heating campaigns are on track to go live October 1.

watch_item.issue: LSA heating toggles remain off past their September 1 due date, suppressing lead volume heading into fall.
watch_item.fix: Re-enabling those toggles is the active priority this week so heating-season traffic can begin flowing before the October 1 campaign launch.
